newsitem.title: SPAIN: Iberia Sept load factor down 2.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Iberia Sept load factor down 2.5 pct.

text.p: Spanish airline Iberia said its passenger load factor dipped 2.55 percent to 72.62 percent in September from 75.17 in August.
It flew 1.37 million passengers and clocked 2.45 billion revenue passenger kilometres (RPK) taking the total so far this year to 11.0 million passengers and 19.45 billion RPK.
It said it carried 56.73 million freight tonne kilometres (FTK) in September or 1.45 percent less than the same month last year.
This brought the total in the first nine months of this year to 521.93 million FTK's or just over eight percent above the same period in 1995.
